journey.name: Turn push notifications on and off
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in, Chrome has not yet been asked about notifications for localhost:3000 (site permission "Ask"), and the server has VAPID keys configured. Delivery itself is covered in README.md (it needs mail sent to the server from outside the device).

actions.action: Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen
Tap "Turn on notifications" near the bottom of the drawer
Tap "Allow" in the Chrome dialog asking whether localhost:3000 may send notifications
Verify that a message reading "Notifications are on for this device." appears
Wait 10 seconds for that message to disappear, then verify that the drawer item now reads "Notifications on" and is highlighted
Tap "Notifications on" to turn notifications off
Verify that a message reading "Notifications are off for this device." appears
Wait 10 seconds for that message to disappear, then verify that the drawer item reads "Turn on notifications" again
